{{Top|leg}}
'''Capital Cay''' was a port [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Aquilaris Minor|Aquilaris]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Control of the city shifted throughout the internecine [[New Sith Wars]]. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], it was occupied by [[Daimanate]] forces. However, it was attacked by both [[Grace Command]] and [[Zodoh]]'s criminal empire during the [[Aquilaris campaign]]. Following a [[Battle of Capital Cay|three-way]] battle, the Republic-affiliated Grace Command occupied the city and liberated the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].
